incidentSummary: A misconfigured cloud storage bucket used for claims document uploads was publicly readable between 2 and 19 October 2026. An external security researcher reported it. Access logs show 3 downloads by unknown IP addresses.
measuresTaken: Bucket access restricted within 35 minutes of the report
All storage buckets audited, no other exposure found
Supervisory authority FDPIC notified on 21 October 2026
Monitoring of affected IBANs for fraudulent direct debits agreed with partner banks
